items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: he got to meet Buddy Rich and Louis Bellson and all those kind of people.

ctx.x: How long has he been playing bass?

Well, he's been interested in music he was 7. I started him out with Bill Douglas. He wanted to play drums, so naturally he had all the best drum-sets, and he got to meet Buddy Rich and Louis Bellson and all those kind of people.
